messages:
Alex: async standup — audits / vuln remediation / IAM-KMS check-in. What I did: finished KMS key rotation run for eu-prod (all keys rotated). No failures in the rotation job itself but saw intermittent 403s from the service that talks to KMS. Blockers: need to confirm IAM binding ordering — looks like a short window where the service account lost kms:Decrypt. Today: dig into IAM policy binding order and push PR to add exponential backoff to the rotation job. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/merge/1234 :thumbsup:

Priya: thanks Alex — I can review the PR after lunch. The 403s sound like eventual consistency on IAM. Which role change caused it? which service account? Can you paste the log snippet?

Alex: sure, here's the relevant tail of the rotation job logs:
```
2026-03-16T13:12:03Z INFO starting rotation for key: eu-prod-kms-01
2026-03-16T13:12:18Z ERROR decrypt failed for sa-inference@eu-prod (status=403)
2026-03-16T13:12:20Z WARN retrying decrypt (attempt=1)
2026-03-16T13:12:24Z ERROR decrypt failed for sa-inference@eu-prod (status=403)
2026-03-16T13:12:35Z INFO decrypt succeeded after retry
```
Looks like a short window of 10–15s.

Jin: I ran a quick RBAC audit this morning and found two policies granting iam.serviceAccounts.get to groups that look overly broad. I opened SEC-3421 and attached the policy diffs. Jira: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SEC-3421

Sam: on vuln remediation — ran the nightly scanner, found a few items. One was a false-positive around kernel32.dll in our dependency scanner (Windows lib flagged in container image). I've suppressed that rule for the internal container baseline and added a note in the SBOM (pkg v0.9.2). Also patched an out-of-date transitive crate flagged as medium.

Priya: compliance note — SOC2 evidence collection: export of KMS rotation logs starts tonight. I kicked off the export to s3://compliance-evidence/2026/q1/kms-rotations.json.gz and started a checksum pass. Reminder: evidence bundle due Friday.

Alex: FYI I scheduled a quick sync at 4:00pm PT to align on IAM rollouts and scan triage — please join if you can. Meeting: https://meet.internal/xyz @Jin @Priya

sec-bot: automated-scan: completed nightly scan (id=1853456789) — summary: 12 high, 2 critical. Created issues: #sec-612, #sec-613. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/security/scan/1853456789

Jin: quick Q: does Dedicated use a separate KMS per customer? @Alex I believe we provision per-customer keys, but we should document the expected policy pattern in infra docs.

Alex: correct — Dedicated uses Core KMS with per-customer keys (customer-key-{id}). I'll add a doc stub: infra/docs/kms.md and link it to SEC-3421 for policy recommendations.

Priya: blocker: I don't have perms to download the full scanner report from the S3 bucket. Can someone grant me security-audit role? @Sam?

Sam: granted security-audit to Priya (aws:iam policy applied). Also left a comment on SEC-3421 with suggested least-priv changes.

Alex: thanks team. Checklist for today: review PR, update IAM policy patch, export full scan and attach to SEC-3421, prep SOC2 evidence bundle. If anything urgent pops up ping #eng-oncall or dm me. :rocket:
